item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Warmer Colours Only

turns.text: Make it warmer—just the colours, please. Don't change anything in the picture.

item.tests: Tests interpreting 'warmer' as a colour-temperature adjustment rather than a scene or weather change.

answer_sheet.Meaning of warmer: A warmer colour balance only, not different weather, a new sunset or added objects.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original 16:9 composition; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Text or other edits: No text and no changes beyond the colours.

must_haves: The image has a visibly warmer colour balance than the source.
The same mountains, pine trees, clouds and lake remain in their original positions.
The lake's reflections and surface details retain their original structure.
No sun, sunset, extra clouds or other scene elements are added.
Framing, geometry and image detail remain unchanged apart from colour.

turns.text: Could you make this pic warmer, please? I've been looking at it for a while and keep coming back to how it feels. To be clear, I only mean the colours. Please don't change anything else in the picture. I'm probably over-explaining because I'm a little nervous about asking for edits.
turns.agent:
Your request was clear, so no need to worry about over-explaining. I couldn't make the edit, though: your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits.

I tried to change only the colours, making them warmer and more golden, and leave the trees, mountains, clouds, water, reflections, rocks and framing exactly as they are. I used the cheapest image editor on the free plan (Flux 2 Klein, about 5 credits). The account refused the request because of insufficient credits, so nothing was made and no credits were spent.

**What you can do:**
- **Get more credits** (wait for your free credits to refill or buy a credit pack). Then tell me and I'll run the same edit.
- **Edit it yourself without credits.** Most photo apps can do this in a few seconds, and nothing else in the picture changes:
  - **Phone (Photos app):** Edit → Adjust → Warmth (iPhone) or Colour/Temp (Android). Slide it up a little.
  - **Desktop (Lightroom, Snapseed, GIMP):** raise the Temperature or White Balance slider towards yellow, and maybe push Tint slightly towards magenta for a sunset feel.

An AI image editor can also slightly redraw small details even when told to change only the colours. If you want everything else to stay exactly the same, the manual slider is the safest choice.
